description: Verify that the client retransmits DHCPREQUEST in RENEWING when no DHCPACK or DHCPNAK is received (RFC 2131 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
If the unicast renewal REQUEST is lost or the server is unreachable, the client must retransmit before T2 — otherwise a single packet loss would make the lease lapse without warning.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DORA → BOUND → T1 → RENEWING → first renew DHCPREQUEST.
2. Tester does NOT reply (no ACK / no NAK).
3. DUT → wire: second renew DHCPREQUEST   ← key check (within (T2-T1)/2 retx window)

[Pass condition]
A second renewing REQUEST is observed within the retx window.

[Fail condition]
Any chain step missing → corresponding Fail_no_* verdict.

verdicts.Fail_no_discover: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_renewing_request: No DUT renewing DHCPREQUEST within listen window
verdicts.Fail_no_second_renewing_request: No DUT second renewing DHCPREQUEST within retx window
verdicts.Fail_unreachable: Sentinel — pass expression always true (debug verdict, not expected to trigger)
